drive_storage.name: drive_storage
drive_storage.value: ("drive_items"."kind" = 'folder' and "drive_items"."object_key" is null and "drive_items"."size" = 0) or ("drive_items"."kind" = 'file' and "drive_items"."object_key" is not null)

hr_employee_dates.name: hr_employee_dates
hr_employee_dates.value: "hr_employees"."end_date" is null or "hr_employees"."hire_date" is null or "hr_employees"."end_date" >= "hr_employees"."hire_date"
